text:
Ethan W.: Hey all, Ethan here — just converted from contractor to full-time today. My Okta login says 'multiple accounts found' and MFA pushes are going to my old contractor phone which I no longer have. Also 1Password shows me as an account holder but no active seat. Need access to Drive and Slack for onboarding. Who do I ping?
People Ops: Congrats Ethan! :tada: Sorry for the friction. We'll loop in IT and Security. @it-support @security can you confirm the safest recovery path for a account-merge and MFA rebind?
IT Support: Hi Ethan, welcome! Can you share the emails associated with the contractor and full-time accounts? Also did you ever set up Okta recovery codes or a secondary authenticator?
Ethan W.: Contractor email was ethan.w+contractor@personal.com and full-time alias is ethan.w@redwood.com. I never saved recovery codes and I don't have the old phone.
Security: For identity proof we'll need a short verification: confirm manager name and last 4 of onboarding ticket ID in DM. After verification we can authorize emergency access. Ethan, please DM People Ops the details and we'll proceed.
Ethan W.: DM'd People Ops with manager (Marta) and ticket info.
People Ops: Verified. Security approved emergency steps. We'll do a temporary account merge and reassign MFA.
onboard-bot: Provisioning action: create_recovery_flow user=ethan.w action=merge_accounts status=initiated
IT Support: Ok, steps we'll take: 1) create a consolidated account ethan.w@redwood.com with employer identity, 2) revoke old contractor device sessions, 3) add you to temp-device-trust for 4h to let you complete onboarding, 4) reassign 1Password seat and send a new invite.
Marta (eng): Ping me once you're in; I'll add you to the team channels and grant repo read access.
IT Support: Ethan, before we enable temp-device-trust can you confirm OS and whether you'll use a company laptop or personal device? Also we will send a one-time SMS and a manual TOTP seed you can enter into an authenticator app.
Ethan W.: Using personal Pixel 7 for now, Chrome on Android 14. Company laptop hasn't shipped yet. SMS to my current phone is fine.
Security: Reminder: temp-device-trust allows limited access; do not use it for privileged operations or CI. We'll log the session for audit.
IT Support: Done. Added you to temp-device-trust for 4h and sent SMS. Also reissued 1Password invite to ethan.w@redwood.com. Check your spam folder.
onboard-bot: Provisioning update: okta=temp_device_trust=enabled duration=4h, 1Password=invite_sent target=ethan.w@redwood.com
Ethan W.: SMS received and used the TOTP seed in Authy. Okta enrollment completed and I can access Drive. 1Password invite arrived and I can sign in. Slack still needs the #eng-intros invite though.
Marta (eng): Invited you to #eng-intros and #onboarding. Also posted the starter ticket with required repos.
Ethan W.: I see the channels and repo links. One quick Q: what happens to my contractor account? Will it be deleted?
People Ops: Good question. We merged identities and will keep the contractor account suspended for 30 days before deprovisioning to allow any data transfer. We'll DM details about calendars and old docs migration.
Security: Audit note: emergency merge executed and logged (audit id: AUD-229000-01). Ethan, once your company device arrives we recommend re-enrolling MFA from the company laptop and removing temporary device trust entries from personal devices.
Ethan W.: Will do. Huge thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround :heart_eyes:
IT Support: Glad it's sorted. If anything else pops up DM IT Support or post here. We'll close the recovery ticket after 48h if no issues.
People Ops: Welcome officially to the team, Ethan! :wave: Here's the onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.com/onboarding/checklist
